name: Family Favourites (Finland)
summary: Everyday dinners that Finnish families cook week after week.

recipes.name: Makaronilaatikko (Finnish macaroni and mince bake)
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C and grease an ovenproof dish.
Boil the macaroni until almost tender and drain.
Brown the mince and chopped onion in the oil and season with salt and pepper.
Mix the macaroni and mince together in the dish.
Whisk the eggs and milk with a pinch of salt and pour over.
Sprinkle with the cheese and bake for about an hour until the egg mixture has set.
Serve with ketchup and a salad.

recipes.name: Spaghetti bolognese
steps: Finely chop the onion and garlic.
Brown the mince in the oil, add the onion and garlic and soften for a moment.
Add the tomatoes, water and seasoning and simmer gently for 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook the spaghetti in salted water.
Serve the sauce with the spaghetti and sprinkle with grated cheese.

recipes.name: Lihapullat (Finnish meatballs) with mash and cream gravy
steps: Mix the breadcrumbs and soured cream and leave to swell for a while.
Add the mince, grated onion, egg and salt and mix until smooth.
Roll into small balls and bake at 225°C for about 15 minutes.
Boil the potatoes until tender and mash with warm milk, butter and salt.
Sprinkle the flour into a pan, add the water and cream and cook into a gravy. Add the meatballs.
Serve the meatballs with the mash, gravy and lingonberries.

recipes.name: Lihakeitto (Finnish beef and root vegetable soup)
steps: Put the meat in cold water, bring to the boil and skim off the foam.
Add the salt, allspice and bay leaves and simmer gently for about an hour.
Peel the onion, potatoes and root vegetables and cut into chunks.
Add the vegetables and cook for another 20–25 minutes until everything is tender.
Check the salt and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Serve with rye bread.

recipes.name: Karjalanpaisti (Karelian beef and pork stew) with mash
ingredients: 800 g Karelian stew meat (mixed beef and pork)
steps: Heat the oven to 175°C.
Put the meat, onion wedges and carrot chunks in a casserole and season with salt, allspice and bay leaves.
Add enough water to just cover the meat.
Cook covered in the oven for 2½–3 hours until the meat is tender.
Boil the potatoes and mash with the milk and butter.
Serve the stew with the mash and lingonberries.

recipes.name: Kaalipata (cabbage and mince stew)
steps: Brown the mince in a large pan.
Add the shredded cabbage, sliced carrots and chopped onion and soften for a moment.
Add the water, rice, syrup and seasoning.
Simmer covered over a low heat for about 40 minutes, stirring now and then.
Boil the potatoes at the same time.
Serve with the potatoes and lingonberries.

recipes.name: Lasagne
steps: Brown the mince and onion, add the tomatoes and seasoning and simmer for 10 minutes.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour and gradually whisk in the milk. Cook until thick and season with salt.
Heat the oven to 200°C.
Layer white sauce, sheets and meat sauce in a dish, finishing with white sauce.
Sprinkle with the cheese and bake for about 45 minutes.
Leave to rest for a few minutes and serve with a salad.

recipes.name: Mince and vegetable soup
steps: Brown the mince in a pan and add the chopped onion.
Add the water, stock cube, allspice and bay leaves and bring to the boil.
Add the diced potatoes and carrots and cook for 15 minutes.
Add the soup vegetables and cook for another 5–10 minutes.
Season with salt, sprinkle with parsley and serve with bread.

recipes.name: Hamburgers with oven chips
steps: Bake the chips in the oven according to the packet.
Season the mince with salt and pepper and shape into four patties.
Fry the patties in the oil for 3–4 minutes on each side.
Put a slice of cheese on each patty towards the end and warm the buns.
Build the burgers with lettuce, tomato, cucumber and the sauces.
Serve with the chips.

recipes.name: Beef burritos
steps: Brown the mince and chopped onion in a frying pan.
Add the rinsed beans, salsa, water and salt and simmer for 5 minutes.
Warm the tortillas.
Spread the filling on the tortillas, add cheese, yoghurt and lettuce and roll up.
Serve straight away.

recipes.name: Nakkikastike (Finnish frankfurter sauce) with mash
steps: Boil the potatoes until tender.
Slice the frankfurters and chop the onion.
Soften the onion in the butter, add the frankfurters and brown lightly.
Sprinkle in the flour, add the water and stock cube and cook until thickened.
Season with the ketchup and mustard, add the cream and simmer for a couple of minutes.
Mash the potatoes with warm milk and butter and serve with the sauce.

recipes.name: Makkarakeitto (sausage and cabbage soup)
ingredients: 750 g frozen potato and soup vegetable mix
steps: Bring the water, stock cubes and spices to the boil.
Add the potato and vegetable mix and cook for 10 minutes.
Add the diced sausage and shredded cabbage and cook for another 5–8 minutes.
Check the seasoning and sprinkle with parsley.
Serve with soured cream and bread.

recipes.name: Uunimakkara (oven-baked ring sausage) with mash
steps: Heat the oven to 225°C.
Cut pockets along the sausage and brush with mustard.
Fill the pockets with cheese, tomato slices and onion.
Bake for about 20 minutes.
Boil the potatoes and mash with the milk, butter and salt.
Serve the sausage with the mash.

recipes.name: Pyttipannu (Finnish potato and sausage hash) with fried eggs
steps: Dice the potatoes, sausage and onions.
Fry the potatoes in the oil until golden.
Add the onion and sausage and fry for about 10 more minutes, stirring now and then.
Season with salt and pepper.
Fry the eggs separately.
Serve the hash with the eggs, beetroot and chives.

recipes.name: Hernekeitto (Finnish pea soup with pork)
steps: Soak the peas overnight in plenty of water and rinse.
Put the peas, water, hock and shoulder in a pan, bring to the boil and skim.
Add the chopped onion and simmer gently for 1½–2 hours.
Add the carrot chunks for the last half hour.
Lift out the meat, remove the bones and chop the meat back into the soup.
Season with salt and marjoram and serve with mustard and bread.

recipes.name: Kinkkukiusaus (creamy ham and potato bake)
ingredients: 1 kg frozen potato and onion mix
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C and grease a dish.
Layer the potato and onion mix and the ham in the dish.
Mix the cream, milk, salt and pepper and pour over.
Sprinkle with the cheese.
Bake for about 50 minutes until the potatoes are tender.
Sprinkle with parsley and serve with a salad.

recipes.name: Pasta carbonara
steps: Cook the spaghetti in salted water.
Fry the bacon until crisp and add the chopped garlic at the end.
Mix the cream, eggs, Parmesan and pepper in a bowl.
Drain the pasta and tip it into the pan with the bacon.
Take the pan off the heat and quickly stir in the egg mixture.
Serve straight away.

recipes.name: Ham pizza
steps: Heat the oven to 250°C.
Mix the flour, baking powder and salt, add the water and oil and knead into a smooth dough.
Roll the dough into two thin bases on baking paper.
Spread with the sauce, ham, pepper strips and cheese and sprinkle with pizza seasoning.
Bake for 10–12 minutes until the edges are golden.
Serve with a salad.

recipes.name: Breaded pork escalopes with potatoes
steps: Boil the potatoes.
Cut the loin into 8 slices, beat them thin and season with salt and pepper.
Dip the escalopes in flour, then beaten egg and finally breadcrumbs.
Fry in the oil over a medium heat for 2–3 minutes on each side.
Serve with the potatoes, lemon wedges and a salad.

recipes.name: Jauhelihakastike (Finnish mince gravy) with potatoes
steps: Boil the potatoes.
Brown the mince and chopped onion in the oil.
Stir in the tomato purée and sprinkle over the flour.
Gradually stir in the water and simmer for 10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper and add the diced gherkin and soured cream.
Serve the gravy with the potatoes.

recipes.name: Creamy pork in mustard sauce with rice
steps: Cook the rice according to the packet.
Brown the pork strips in the oil and season with salt.
Add the chopped onion and garlic and soften for a moment.
Add the mustard, water and cream and simmer for 10 minutes.
Season with pepper and scatter over the basil.
Serve with the rice.

recipes.name: Pork and vegetable noodle stir-fry
steps: Cook the noodles according to the packet and drain.
Stir-fry the pork strips in hot oil in a wok or frying pan.
Add the sliced pepper, leek, garlic and beans and stir-fry for a few minutes.
Add the soy sauce and coconut milk and heat through.
Toss in the noodles and season with the lime juice.
Serve straight away.

recipes.name: Chicken pasta
steps: Cook the pasta.
Brown the chicken strips in the oil.
Add the diced vegetables and fry for a few minutes.
Add the tomato purée, seasoning and water and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir the pasta into the sauce and sprinkle with the cheese.
Serve straight away.

recipes.name: Chicken in creamy mustard and tomato sauce with rice
steps: Cook the rice.
Brown the chicken strips in the oil and season with salt and pepper.
Add the mustard, water and cream and bring to the boil.
Add the diced tomatoes and simmer for 5 minutes.
Sprinkle with chives and serve with the rice.

recipes.name: Creamy chicken soup
steps: Soften the chopped onion with the curry powder in the oil in a large pan.
Add the chicken strips and brown lightly.
Add the water, stock cube and diced potatoes and carrots.
Cook for about 20 minutes until the potatoes are tender.
Add the cream, season with salt and heat through.
Sprinkle with parsley and serve with bread.

recipes.name: Mild chicken curry with rice
steps: Cook the rice.
Brown the chicken strips in the oil and add the curry powder.
Add the thinly sliced leek and soften for a moment.
Add the water, salt, peas and cream and simmer for 5–10 minutes.
Sprinkle with parsley and serve with the rice.

recipes.name: Chicken and rice bake
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C and grease a dish.
Brown the chicken strips in the oil and add the chopped leek and courgette.
Spread the rice in the dish and top with the chicken, vegetables and pineapple.
Mix the water, stock cube, cream and cheese sauce and pour over.
Sprinkle with the cheese and bake for about 45 minutes until the rice is cooked.

recipes.name: Chicken tortilla bake
steps: Heat the oven to 225°C.
Fry the chicken strips in the oil and add the sliced vegetables.
Season with the fajita seasoning and lime juice.
Spread the tortillas with crème fraîche, add the filling, roll up and place in a dish.
Sprinkle with the cheese and bake for about 15 minutes.
Serve with a salad.

recipes.name: Chicken nuggets with potato wedges
ingredients: cucumber and carrot sticks, to serve
steps: Heat the oven to 225°C. Cut the potatoes into wedges, toss with oil and salt and roast for 30–35 minutes.
Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and season with salt and paprika.
Coat the pieces in flour, beaten egg and panko.
Fry the nuggets in oil until cooked through.
Serve with the wedges and vegetable sticks.

recipes.name: Chicken stir-fry with rice
steps: Cook the rice.
Brown the chicken strips in hot oil and season with the ginger and curry powder.
Add the vegetables and stir-fry for a few minutes.
Mix the potato starch with the cold water and soy sauce and pour into the pan.
Heat until the sauce thickens.
Serve with the rice.

recipes.name: Pan-fried chicken breasts with potatoes
steps: Boil the potatoes.
Mix the oil, curry powder, paprika and salt and brush over the chicken.
Fry in a hot pan for 3–4 minutes on each side until cooked through.
Mix the soured cream with chopped chives for a dip.
Serve the chicken with the potatoes, dip and a salad.

recipes.name: Sweet and sour chicken with rice
ingredients: 1 jar (350 g) sweet and sour sauce
steps: Cook the rice.
Brown the chicken strips in the oil.
Add the pepper and carrot strips and fry for a couple of minutes.
Add the sauce, water and pineapple and simmer for 5 minutes.
Serve with the rice.

recipes.name: Creamy chicken and mushroom stew with potatoes
steps: Boil the potatoes.
Cut the chicken into pieces and brown in the oil in a casserole.
Add the chopped onion, carrots and mushrooms and soften for a moment.
Add the water, stock cube, cream, mustard and honey.
Simmer covered over a low heat for about 30 minutes.
Season with salt and serve with the potatoes.

recipes.name: Lohikeitto (Finnish creamy salmon soup)
steps: Bring the water, stock cubes, allspice and bay leaf to the boil.
Add the diced potatoes and chopped onion and cook for about 15 minutes.
Remove the skin and bones from the salmon and cut into cubes.
Add the cream and salmon and simmer gently for 5 minutes.
Stir in the butter and plenty of dill.
Serve with rye bread.

recipes.name: Oven-baked salmon with dill sauce and potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C and boil the potatoes.
Place the salmon skin side down in an ovenproof dish and season with salt.
Bake for about 20 minutes until the fish is cooked.
Mix the soured cream, lemon juice and dill into a sauce.
Serve the salmon with the potatoes, sauce and lemon wedges.

recipes.name: Fish fingers with mash and peas
steps: Boil the potatoes.
Partly thaw the fish, cut into fingers and season with salt and pepper.
Dip the fingers in beaten egg and coat in panko.
Fry the fish fingers in the oil until golden.
Mash the potatoes with the milk and butter and cook the peas.
Serve the fish fingers with the mash and peas.

recipes.name: Lohikiusaus (creamy salmon and potato bake)
ingredients: 1 kg frozen potato and onion mix
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C.
Remove the skin from the fish and cut into cubes.
Layer potato, fish and dill in a dish, seasoning each layer with salt and pepper.
Pour over the cream.
Bake for about 50 minutes until the potatoes are tender and the top is golden.

recipes.name: Tuna pasta in tomato sauce
steps: Cook the spaghetti.
Heat the oil from the tuna in a pan and soften the chopped garlic.
Add the halved tomatoes and passata and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the cream and tuna and season with salt and pepper.
Toss the spaghetti in the sauce and serve with Parmesan.

recipes.name: Creamy salmon pasta
steps: Cook the pasta.
Soften the chopped onion and garlic in the oil.
Add the cream and heat through.
Add the diced fish and simmer gently for 5 minutes.
Season with salt, pepper and lemon juice and add the herbs.
Toss with the pasta and serve.

recipes.name: Silakkapihvit (fried Baltic herring fillets) with mash
steps: Boil the potatoes.
Rinse the herring and pat dry with kitchen paper.
Season the fillets with salt and pepper and sandwich them in pairs with chopped dill in between.
Coat the pairs in breadcrumbs and fry in the butter until golden on both sides.
Mash the potatoes with warm milk.
Serve the herring with the mash and lingonberries.

recipes.name: Pollock and leek bake with potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C and boil the potatoes.
Soften the leek in the oil in a pan, stir in the flour and then gradually add the milk.
Melt the cheese into the sauce and season with salt and pepper.
Place the fish in a dish and pour over the sauce.
Bake for about 25 minutes until the fish is cooked.
Sprinkle with dill and serve with the potatoes.

recipes.name: Rainbow trout patties with potatoes
steps: Boil the potatoes.
Skin the fish and chop it finely with a knife or food processor.
Mix in the egg, flour, salt, pepper, dill and grated lemon zest.
Shape into patties and fry in the oil for 3–4 minutes on each side.
Serve with the potatoes, lemon wedges and a salad.

recipes.name: Pinaattiletut (Finnish spinach pancakes) with lingonberries
steps: Thaw the spinach.
Whisk the milk, flour, eggs, salt and sugar into a smooth batter and leave to rest for 15 minutes.
Stir the spinach and oil into the batter.
Fry small pancakes on both sides in a greased pan.
Serve with lingonberry jam and cottage cheese.

recipes.name: Pannukakku (Finnish oven pancake) with jam
steps: Heat the oven to 225°C and melt the butter on a baking tray lined with baking paper.
Whisk the eggs and milk together.
Mix the dry ingredients and whisk them into the milk mixture.
Leave the batter to rest for 15 minutes and pour it onto the tray.
Bake for about 30 minutes until golden.
Serve with jam and whipped cream.

recipes.name: Creamy vegetable soup
steps: Peel and chop the carrots, parsnip and onion and cut the courgette into chunks.
Simmer the vegetables in the water with the stock cube and thyme until soft, about 20 minutes.
Blend the soup with a stick blender.
Stir in the cream cheese and season with salt.
Serve with bread.

recipes.name: Finnish spinach soup with boiled eggs
steps: Hard-boil the eggs for 8–10 minutes.
Melt the butter in a pan and stir in the flour.
Gradually whisk in the milk and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the spinach and seasoning and heat through.
Serve the soup with the halved eggs and bread.

recipes.name: Baked feta pasta
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C.
Put the tomatoes and garlic in a dish, place the feta in the middle, drizzle with the oil and season.
Bake for about 25 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook the spaghetti.
Crush the feta and tomatoes into a sauce and stir in the pasta.
Scatter over the basil and serve.

recipes.name: Vegetable noodle stir-fry with oat strips
steps: Cook the noodles and drain.
Fry the oat strips in the oil in a wok.
Add the sliced carrots, peas, cabbage and garlic and stir-fry for a few minutes.
Add the hoisin and soy sauces and the noodles and toss together.
Sprinkle with spring onions and serve.

recipes.name: Roasted vegetable and halloumi pittas
steps: Heat the oven to 225°C.
Chop the vegetables, toss with the oil and seasoning and roast on a tray for 15–20 minutes.
Fry the sliced halloumi in a pan until golden.
Warm the pittas.
Fill the pittas with lettuce, vegetables, halloumi and garlic mayonnaise and scatter over the basil.

recipes.name: Red lentil soup
steps: Chop the onion and garlic and dice the carrots and pepper.
Soften the vegetables in the oil in a pan.
Add the tomato purée and paprika and fry for a moment.
Add the water, stock cube and rinsed lentils and simmer for about 20 minutes.
Blend the soup if you like and season with salt.
Sprinkle with parsley and serve with bread.
